subject.title: Exec/tool failures show "(see attached image)" and suppress model response

question: Should this issue remain the umbrella for the residual zero-payload/tool-error fallback policy, or should its evidence be split into the existing placeholder and incomplete-turn issues?
rationale: Current main has only partially fixed the reported behavior, and the remaining change decides user-visible warning/fallback policy around failed tools and replay safety rather than a purely mechanical typo fix.

options.title: Keep as residual policy bug
options.body: Use this issue to decide the no-reply/tool-error fallback semantics while linking placeholder-only reports to the broader placeholder issue.

options.title: Split into existing reports
options.body: Move placeholder evidence to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/96857 and zero-payload replay evidence to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/97324, then close this issue after preserving context.

options.title: Authorize narrow repair now
options.body: Sponsor a focused fix in the embedded-runner payload/incomplete-turn surfaces without waiting for a fresh live repro, accepting the replay-safety review burden.

recommendation.title: Keep as residual policy bug
recommendation.body: Use this issue to decide the no-reply/tool-error fallback semantics while linking placeholder-only reports to the broader placeholder issue.
